title: DRDA: Support SQLSTT properly
description:
SQLSTT consists of two strings, one in the mixed character encoding
CCSID and one in the single byte encoding, only one of which can be
nonzero length.

Later versions of DRDA (SQLAM level 7 and higher) support SQL statements
with greater than 16 bit lengths by using nullable CLOBs instead of
LONG VARCHARs. Perhaps later we could store that from the SQLAM in the
MGRLVLLS in the EXCSAT and EXCSATRD, but it's also simple to do a
heuristic for it.

Fix #18965.
